title: Pattern Copy · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Pattern Copy · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: A partner draws a short repeating pattern of circles and triangles. The lead continues the pattern for four more shapes. All four shapes follow the original repeating rule. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Pattern Copy, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
All four shapes follow the original repeating rule.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: All four shapes follow the original repeating rule.
